(* Declaration rebuilt from the structured interface: comments, pragmas and attributes are missing; an omitted type reads UNKNOWN. *)
PROGRAM LD_TEST
VAR
    Sensor1 : BOOL;
    Sensor2 : BOOL;
    sensor3 : BOOL;
    PowerOn : BOOL;
    TON_0 : TON;
    CTU_0 : CTU;
    PowerOff : BOOL;
END_VAR

(* Network 1 *)
IF (Sensor1 OR sensor3) AND NOT Sensor2 THEN PowerOn := TRUE; END_IF

(* Network 2 *)
TON_0(IN := PowerOn, PT := T#5S);
CTU_0(CU := TON_0.Q, RESET := PowerOff, PV := 10);
IF CTU_0.Q THEN PowerOff := FALSE; END_IF
